g.text: Forty-eight OpenEarthMap regions in two disjoint roles
development region (5 images); wedges show its role in source0 (top), then source1 and source2 (clockwise)
Three cyclic source allocations of the 24 development regions

Each allocation: 12 training regions (60 images; candidate pools of 36), 4 validation regions (20 images), 8 unused. The 24 panel regions (72 images) are never used for selection, fitting or calibration.
